verified: According to electrive's report, Toyota is recalling roughly 19,000 C-HR+ electric vehicles worldwide, including 1,096 units in Germany, because of a fault in the battery management system that could, in the worst case, shut down the electric drivetrain.
unconfirmed: The report is a single trade-press account and does not quote a Toyota recall notice, so the official scope (affected model years and build dates), the fix (software update versus hardware replacement of the battery control unit), the start date of the campaign, and whether any drivetrain shutdowns, crashes or injuries have actually occurred remain unconfirmed.

verified: 据 electrive 报道，丰田将在全球召回约 19,000 辆 C-HR+ 纯电车型，其中德国市场 1,096 辆，原因是电池管理系统（负责监控与保护动力电池的控制单元）存在故障，最坏情况下可能导致电驱动系统断电停摆。
unconfirmed: 丰田官方召回公告或监管机构（如德国 KBA）的备案文件未在来源中出现，因此具体受影响年款、故障触发条件、维修方案（软件升级还是更换控制单元）、是否免费以及是否已有实际道路故障或事故报告，均只有该单一行业媒体报道这一层信息，尚无独立核实。

titles.en: Toyota recalls about 19,000 C-HR+ EVs over battery control fault
titles.zh: 丰田全球召回约1.9万辆C-HR+，电池管理单元故障或致动力中断
